gradePoints.caveat: Exact cutoffs can vary slightly by faculty/programme ordinance (e.g. B.Tech-style courses under other faculties sometimes use different bands). Treat this table as the correct DEFAULT for CBCS/UGCF undergraduate arts/commerce/science programmes; do not assume it applies unmodified to professional courses (BMS, B.El.Ed, law) without checking that programme's specific ordinance.

cgpaToPercentageFormula.sourceDate: 2018-04-16 (still current per multiple 2024-2025 corroborating student-forum answers)
cgpaToPercentageFormula.officialContext: DU adopted the UGC-recommended 'multiplier factor of 9.5' from the 2018-19 session onward, specifically for converting CBCS CGPA into percentage for PG admission cutoffs (DU reserves 50% of PG seats for its own graduates on a percentage-based cutoff).
cgpaToPercentageFormula.correctionNotice: An earlier version of this spec used the formula (CGPA - 0.5) x 10. That formula is real but belongs to a DIFFERENT university (confirmed source: Jharkhand University of Technology, Ranchi ordinance). It does not apply to DU. Use CGPA x 9.5 for all DU-facing CGPA-to-percentage conversions in this app.

attendanceOrdinance.verified: partially — 66.67% minimum attendance is the figure consistently cited across DU college handbooks and student-facing DU documentation, but the fetch agent was not able to pull the exact ordinance clause number and text in this pass
attendanceOrdinance.note: Individual colleges may grant condonation for medical/documented reasons per DU ordinance provisions on attendance shortage; exact condonation process varies by college and should not be hardcoded as a single university-wide workflow.

exitPoints.award: Bachelor's Degree with Honours / Honours with Research / Honours with Entrepreneurship

nepExitPoints.reEntry: Students may re-enter within 7 years of exit; earned-credit validity is 2-4 years depending on the exit qualification. This applies only to UGCF 2022 (NEP, 4-year) batches, not legacy 3-year programmes.
